resources.string: Optional starter files: a Qwen intent candidate, Whisper Small, Silero VAD and Supertonic voice pack. Downloads need internet and storage. Your documents stay on this phone. Installing does not select models or prove their quality.
Starter files are installed and checked. Choose a listening model and try a voice before use. The intent model remains an unselected candidate.
Setup is paused. Resume it, remove only its verified additions, or keep the files.
Setup did not finish. Check connection and storage, then resume or keep the downloaded files.
Some files were kept because they are in use, changed, or their setup ownership is unknown. Retry after resolving this, or keep all files.
Removing files owned by this setup…
Keeping files clears this setup receipt. Nothing is deleted or selected; later removal uses the individual model controls.
